observations: Photo 0 shows a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO multifunction laser printer/copier with a control panel and paper drawers.
The front lower label in photo 0 appears to read 'bizhub PRO C754e'.
There is visible plastic wrap/packing material around the machine in photo 0.
No close-up of the screen, counters, toner/drum status, or any error indicators in photo 0.

claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e unit (front label) consistent with a full-colour MFP form factor.
Photo 0 does not show the machine’s page counter/total prints.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show drum/toner part numbers, replacement dates, or open compartments.
Photo 0 shows no jam/error display and no proof of a test print.

risks.risk: Actual page count may be much higher than claimed (affects wear and service cost).
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the internal counters (total prints and colour prints) from the machine’s menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used unit (worst case: not low page count).

risks.risk: Drum/toner may not be genuinely new, may be mismatched, or may be near end-of-life (affects print quality and replacement cost).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the installed consumables with visible part numbers/labels, plus a receipt/invoice or replacement sticker if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as consumables unknown/possibly worn (worst case: needs replacement soon).

risks.risk: Paper path issues or intermittent jams may exist (not visible in a single photo).
risks.proof: Video/clip of a full test run: loading paper, printing a multi-page document, and showing no jam/error on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential paper-jam/maintenance risk (worst case: not reliably jam-free).

risks.risk: Missing/failed accessories (e.g., finisher, bypass tray, network/scan options) or incomplete configuration.
risks.proof: Photos of all included trays/attachments and a menu screen showing installed options; also show network/scan settings page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as base unit only with unknown options (worst case: limited functionality).

risks.risk: Condition/transport damage (rollers, fuser, sensors) may not show externally.
risks.proof: A short print-quality test: sample pages (all colours) and a photo of any maintenance/error history if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition (worst case: may require servicing).

proof_requests: Clear photo/screenshot of the machine’s total page counter (and colour page counter if available).
Close-up photos of installed toner and drum labels/part numbers (and any replacement sticker/date).
Video/clip of a test print (multi-page) showing no paper jam and no error messages on the screen.
Photos of all included accessories/trays and a menu screen showing installed options (finisher/scan/network).
Print-quality sample (colour test page) to confirm no banding/colour issues.
response.reason: The model appears readable in the photo, but the key pricing drivers (page count, new consumables, and jam-free operation) are not verifiable from the single image. Request counter proof and a test-print/jam-free demonstration before pricing.
